scope:
Candidate-specific buffer, matrix crosstalk and LED numerical sensitivity.

All output stages and uniform return planes are assumptions. No IBIS, clamp,
3-D return-path, EMC certification or physical LED qualification is implied.
crosstalk_scope: Four extracted neighbour envelopes, uniform outer-microstrip approximation, all coupled length placed at minimum gap; one matrix aggressor at a time. Width=max actual net width. Not a strict bound or exhaustive 3D coupling analysis.
numerical_scope: All 37 flagged LED cases plus four fast-driver controls: 0.025 ns vs 0.2 ns max step, reltol 1e-4. Spatial ladder unchanged.
